answer_1.quote: By leveraging their ability to handle diverse inputs and generate structured outputs, LLMs can provide rapid, data-driven solutions for network reconfiguration... Our Contributions: In this paper, we introduce LLM4DistReconfig, a novel approach utilizing fine-tuned large language models to solve the power distribution network reconfiguration problem.
answer_1.outputs: Structured outputs including updated open lines, node voltages, and system loss in a predefined format

answer_2.quote: The metrics included the number of suboptimal configuration, cycles, subgraphs, and average inference time... We also present the mean absolute error (MAE) of the inferred and actual network operating voltages.
automatic_metrics: Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of node voltages
